## Type of Change

- [ ] feat: new feature
- [ ] fix: bug fix

- [ ] docs: documentation only

## Checklist

- [ ] GPG-signed commits
- [ ] `flutter analyze` passes with 0 errors
- [ ] `flutter test` passes (excluding golden tests)
- [ ] New tests added for new functionality
- [ ] Architecture rules respected (layer imports verified)
- [ ] Documentation updated if public API changed
- [ ] No magic numbers, hardcoded values, or empty catch blocks
- [ ] Tested on a physical device
